The '''Yrrna system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cargo transfer area was located here until it was attacked in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by the [[Nami]], led by [[Ali Tarrak]] who sent a full force of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] to destroy the facility. Having built their own TIE Defenders from a prototype stolen from the Empire, the Nami used the attack as a demonstration for their allies in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], with the eventual intention of selling the starfighter to them. The cargo site was completely destroyed, though its personnel were saved on the freighter ''[[Ulzepdi]]'' through a reactionary strike led by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
